mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased corporate costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with subsequent wage inflation.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO MoM < -1% does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdowns.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the specified condition does not correlate with subsequent negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5% in 3 months and PAYEMS decreases by more than 100,000, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 3 months and PAYEMS decreases > 100,000
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the specified condition does not correlate with subsequent negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals strong demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% YoY and Industrial Production (INDPRO) is decreasing, it signals a supply-side slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the specified condition does not correlate with subsequent negative returns.
